messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few well‑known documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Director | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Davis Guggenheim | Former Vice President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change, its impacts, and solutions. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | Davis Guggenheim | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and calls for urgent action. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Fisher Stevens | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to meet scientists, activists, and leaders, highlighting the human cost of climate change. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | Various | A concise overview of the science, impacts, and policy responses to climate change. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Leila Conner | A global perspective on environmental degradation, featuring interviews with scientists, activists, and business leaders. |

All of these films are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or can be rented/bought on iTunes, Google Play, or YouTube Movies. If you’d like more details on a specific documentary—such as runtime, availability, or critical reception—just let me know!
